titleEn: Royal Decree on the Organization and Functioning of the National Council of Science and Technology

articles.en:
.
A National Council of Science and Technology is hereby created, abbreviated as NCST (K.J.V.B.), in order to promote the development of science and technology in Cambodia so that it advances as in the advanced countries of the region and of the world.

,
NCST shall be composed as follows: Samdech Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia — Chairperson; - Minister of Planning — Permanent Vice-Chairperson; - Minister of Industry and Handicrafts — Vice-Chairperson; - Minister of Mines and Energy — Vice-Chairperson; - Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries — Vice-Chairperson; - Minister of Education, Youth and Sport — Vice-Chairperson; - Minister of Posts and Telecommunications — Vice-Chairperson; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Planning — Vice-Chairperson; - One Secretary of State of the Office of the Council of Ministers — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Interior — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Economy and Finance — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Commerce — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Information — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Public Works and Transport — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Justice — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Health — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training — Member;
2 - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Environment — Member; - Secretary of State of the Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Water Resources and Meteorology — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Rural Development — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Tourism — Member; - One Under-Secretary of State of the State Secretariat of Civil Aviation — Member; - One Deputy Secretary General of the Cambodian Rehabilitation and Development Board — Member; - One Deputy Chairperson of the Supreme National Economic Council — Member; - Representatives of research institutions — [number illegible] — Member; - One representative of the Cambodian Chamber of Commerce — Member; - Secretary General of NCST — Secretary.
The actual composition of NCST shall be appointed by a decision of the Royal Government.
Chapter 3 Roles and Duties of NCST
NCST shall have the following roles and duties: - To prepare and promote the implementation of laws and legal instruments, policies, strategic plans, master plans, action plans and programmes for national science and technology development; - To determine the requirements in science and technology submitted by ministries and institutions; - To examine and decide on the proposals of the Cambodian Committee of Science and Technology or of the General Secretariat of NCST; - To mobilise assistance and support in financial, technical and human resources required by institutions or entities involved in the development of science and technology; - To determine priorities for scientific and technological work in the short term, medium term and long term; - To instil understanding, appreciation and sharing of science and technology, and to promote and encourage the participation and advancement of all stakeholders in science and technology development; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Water Resources and Meteorology — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Culture and Fine Arts — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Rural Development — Member; - One Secretary of State of the Ministry of Tourism — Member; - One Under-Secretary of State of the State Secretariat of Civil Aviation — Member; - One Deputy Secretary General of the Cambodian Rehabilitation and Development Board — Member; - One Deputy Chairperson of the Supreme National Economic Council — Member; - Representatives of research institutions — [number illegible] — Member; - One representative of the Cambodian Chamber of Commerce — Member; - Secretary General of NCST — Secretary.
The actual composition of NCST shall be appointed by a decision of the Royal Government.
Chapter 3 Roles and Duties of NCST

- NCST shall have the following roles and duties:
- To prepare and promote the implementation of laws and legal instruments, policies, strategic plans, master plans, action plans and programmes for national science and technology development; - To determine the requirements in science and technology submitted by ministries and institutions; - To examine and decide on the proposals of the Cambodian Committee of Science and Technology or of the General Secretariat of NCST; - To mobilise assistance and support in financial, technical and human resources required by institutions or entities involved in the development of science and technology; - To determine priorities for scientific and technological work in the short term, medium term and long term; - To instil understanding, appreciation and sharing of science and technology and to promote and encourage the participation and advancement of all stakeholders in science and technology development; - To determine principles for human resource development in order to serve the requirements and the development of science and technology; - To strengthen and expand international cooperation in the field of science and technology; - To monitor, inspect and evaluate the implementation of laws and legal instruments, policies, strategic plans, master plans, action plans and programmes and projects in science and technology, and to report to the Royal Government; - To perform other duties assigned by the Royal Government.

- NCST shall hold meetings at least 2 (two) times in 1 (one) year. Where necessary, NCST
may hold extraordinary meetings.
Members of NCST shall attend meetings at the invitation of the Chairperson. The Chairperson may delegate to the Permanent Vice-Chairperson or a Vice-Chairperson the right to lead the meeting under the delegation of the Chairperson.
- The Chairperson of NCST may invite representatives of ministries and institutions, relevant experts, national and international organisations and private entities to attend and provide opinions where necessary.
NCST may have a number of technical advisers and national and international experts as necessary.
NCST shall have the right to use a separate seal, the model of which is attached as an annex.
The procedure for the meetings of NCST shall be determined by internal rules.

.
NCST shall have a General Secretariat as staff for the operation of daily work, located at the Ministry of Planning.
The General Secretariat of NCST shall be headed by one Secretary General who shall be appointed by Royal Decree, assisted by a number of Deputy Secretaries General as necessary, who shall be appointed by Royal Decree or Sub-Decree.

.
A Cambodian Committee of Science and Technology is hereby created, subordinate to NCST
in order to assist the technical work.
The organisation and functioning of this Cambodian Committee of Science and Technology shall be determined by sub-decree.
Chapter 5
Sources of Resources

- The expenses for the operation of NCST shall be supplied by the national budget within the budget project of the Ministry of Planning.
NCST shall have the right to receive and to manage and use, in accordance with existing legal procedures, funds obtained from other sources for the operation of its work.

- Any provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.
Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for the implementation of this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards.
Done at Phnom Penh, on the 13th day of [month illegible] 2014, in the Royal Name and in accordance with the Royal Command — Acting Head of State, signature and Royal Seal
